title.en: Eight U.S. states file coordinated consumer-protection lawsuits against OpenAI
title.zhHans: 美国八州协调提起针对 OpenAI 的消费者保护诉讼

searchSummary.en: Attorneys general from Arizona, Arkansas, Idaho, Iowa, Kansas, Montana, Nebraska, and West Virginia filed coordinated state-court lawsuits alleging that OpenAI misled consumers about ChatGPT’s safety.
searchSummary.zhHans: 亚利桑那、阿肯色、爱达荷、爱荷华、堪萨斯、蒙大拿、内布拉斯加和西弗吉尼亚八州总检察长协调提起州法院诉讼，指控 OpenAI 在 ChatGPT 安全性方面误导消费者。

summary.en: Attorneys general from Arizona, Arkansas, Idaho, Iowa, Kansas, Montana, Nebraska, and West Virginia filed coordinated state-court lawsuits alleging that OpenAI misled consumers about ChatGPT’s safety.
summary.zhHans: 亚利桑那、阿肯色、爱达荷、爱荷华、堪萨斯、蒙大拿、内布拉斯加和西弗吉尼亚八州总检察长协调提起州法院诉讼，指控 OpenAI 在 ChatGPT 安全性方面误导消费者。

narrative.en: The coordinated filings are distinct from Florida’s earlier case because they were brought by eight separate states under their own consumer-protection laws. They are allegations seeking relief, not findings of liability or binding precedent.
narrative.zhHans: 这些协调诉讼不同于佛罗里达较早的案件，因为它们由八个州分别依据各自的消费者保护法提起。它们属于寻求救济的指控，而非认定责任或具有约束力的先例。

text.en: Eight state attorneys general filed coordinated state-court lawsuits against OpenAI on October 14, 2026.
text.zhHans: 八州总检察长于 2026 年 10 月 14 日协调提起针对 OpenAI 的州法院诉讼。

text.en: The lawsuits assert allegations under state consumer-protection laws; they do not establish liability or a judicial remedy.
text.zhHans: 这些诉讼依据州消费者保护法提出指控；它们并不认定 OpenAI 承担责任，也不构成司法救济。
